It was a big year for defense and aerospace stocks, with names like GE Aerospace (GE) and RTX (RTX) up more than 50% in 2025. Gabelli Funds Portfolio Manager Tony Bancroft, who manages the Gabelli Funds Commercial Aerospace and Defense ETF (GCAD), expects the outperformance to continue into 2026.
